findings.body: In DrawViewPart::getDirsFromFront(), the code uses `viewType` (string) instead of `viewType` (ProjDirection) to determine the direction. This causes slices along wrong tensor dimensions to be un-padded. The fix requires casting `viewType` to `ProjDirection` before passing it to `getDirsFromFront`. The line range is 1336-1336.

overall.overall_explanation: The code incorrectly uses a string parameter for direction handling, which causes slices along wrong tensor dimensions to be un-padded. The fix requires casting the string parameter to the correct `ProjDirection` enum type before passing it to the function.
